newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA ISSUES 899.38 BLN LEI IN T-BILLS IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA ISSUES 899.38 BLN LEI IN T-BILLS IN MARCH.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said on Monday it would offer 899.38 billion lei worth of floating-rate treasury bills this month to finance the budget deficit and cover maturing papers.
The T-bills, to be placed by the central bank through four public subscriptions, offer an annual yield calculated at the average on the BNR's weekly auctioned credits rates during their life period.
But traders said they expected only a few banks to subscribe this week for the Finance Ministry papers as the money market was struggling to cope with an acute leu squeeze.

At the latest refinancing credit auction the rate for the BNR's one-week funds soared to an annual 426.5 percent from 226 percent following a central bank dirive to tighten monetary policy to fight surging inflation.
Year-on-year inflation rose to 76.3 percent in January from 56.9 percent last December.
The bills might be bought by commercial banks operating in Romania and their corporate clients.
